[https://support.symbol.com/support/search.do?cmd=displayKC&docType=kc&externalId=10278&sliceId=&dialogID=536584509&stateId=1%200%20536588099 Downloads] "WE701-IF" and "REV D" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. :This device is a [[CyberTAN WE701-I]]. The FCC ID of the WE701-I (N89-WE701I) has also been assigned to this entry. The PCI ID is per the drivers provided by '''Symbol'''. :It would ''appear'' that this device is using ISL3890. :The device description string in the driver is '''Symbol LA-5030 Wireless Networker 802.11a/g CardBus Adapter'''. The OUI in this entry is per a US-acquired (presumably Worldwide variant) LA-5030-102-WW. :This device was specifically noted as being Made in China. The existing Taiwan CoM is, thus, being overwritten. It may be possible that there are multiple CoO for this device.
